Container.Name: iCloud-MCP
Container.Overview: Hardened multi-agent MCP server for iCloud Mail, Calendar and Contacts. HTTP authentication is mandatory. Destructive capabilities are disabled by default.
Container.Requires: An Apple app-specific password. Use a reverse proxy with TLS when the MCP endpoint crosses a trusted LAN boundary.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Streamable HTTP endpoint is /mcp.

Config.Name: Persistent Data
Config.Description: Idempotency database; include this path in normal appdata backups.

Config.Name: MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Long random compatibility token. For per-agent scopes use MCP Clients JSON instead.

Config.Name: MCP Clients JSON
Config.Description: Scoped clients, e.g. [{"id":"reader","token":"...","scopes":["mail:read"]}].

Config.Name: iCloud Email
Config.Description: Apple/iCloud account email.

Config.Name: App-Specific Password
Config.Description: Apple app-specific password, not the Apple ID password.

Config.Name: Allowed Recipients
Config.Description: Comma-separated exact addresses. Empty allows all recipients.

Config.Name: Calendar Writes
Config.Description: Permit event creation and updates for clients with calendar:write.

Config.Name: Calendar Deletes
Config.Description: Permit event deletion for clients with calendar:delete.

Config.Name: Calendar Invitations
Config.Description: Send invitation/update/cancellation emails. The agent also needs mail:send.

Config.Name: Contact Writes
Config.Description: Permit contact creation and updates.

Config.Name: Contact Deletes
Config.Description: Permit contact deletion.

Config.Name: Mail Writes
Config.Description: Permit move/read-state operations.

Config.Name: Mail Deletes
Config.Description: Permit moving mail to trash.

Config.Name: Permanent Mail Deletes
Config.Description: Permit irreversible IMAP deletion in addition to Mail Deletes.

Config.Name: Mail Send
Config.Description: Permit SMTP sending for clients with mail:send.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for naive calendar values, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: Signed Resource Key
Config.Description: Optional HMAC key for opaque signed Calendar/Contact IDs.

Config.Name: Allow Legacy URL IDs
Config.Description: Keep true during migration; set false after all agents use signed IDs.

Config.Name: Audit Logging
Config.Description: Structured authorization audit events on container stderr.

Config.Name: Audit HMAC Key
Config.Description: Secret key used to pseudonymize audit targets consistently.

Config.Name: Idempotency Database
Config.Description: Persistent retry-protection database inside the mapped data path.

Config.Name: HTTP Timeout
Config.Description: Outbound timeout in seconds.
